title: Update flow & faster close
changes: The 'new version' button now glows only 3 times instead of blinking forever.
Changelog is now one click away: a dedicated CHANGES button in the header.
Update dialog now shows the release notes and the installed -> available version, plus a 'View release on GitHub' link alongside the direct ZIP download.
The app no longer waits ~3 seconds to close (WebView2 private mode disabled).

title: Author attribution
changes: Copyright notice now names the author (RAlexander777) instead of the generic "spicetify contributors", so any derivative must credit the author.
Packaging metadata now declares the MIT license and the author.

title: Reliable marketplace apply & in-app changelog
changes: Marketplace install/uninstall now runs spicetify apply with a recovery cascade (restore backup apply -> backup apply -> apply) so a Spotify auto-update can't silently block the change.
Close all Spotify helper processes (WebHelper, CrashService, etc.) before patching, not just Spotify.exe.
Uninstall now verifies the extension is actually gone after apply and reports a clear error if it is not.
Extensions and custom apps configured outside Spicetifix (e.g. via spicetify config) are preserved when rebuilding the config, so they are no longer dropped.
Show the app version and release notes (changelog) inside the About dialog.

title: JSON i18n & marketplace apply fix
changes: Move translations to JSON files (en/es) loaded dynamically.
Fix mixed-language strings across the UI.
Marketplace install/uninstall: close Spotify before spicetify apply and report the real failure code instead of a silent 'ok'.
Visual hierarchy rework for cards and sections.
Remove dead assets and leftover project files.

title: Security hardening & auto-update
changes: API auth token and path-traversal protection for static files.
Built-in auto-update checker with release download.
Fix marketplace extensions installed in subfolders.
Recover System now cascades spicetify restore/backup/apply commands.
Bundle pywebview properly so the native window works.

title: Native window & auth
changes: Run in a native pywebview window instead of a browser tab.
API token authentication between the UI and the Python sidecar.

title: Marketplace tab & stability
changes: Marketplace tab with pagination, search, filters and GitHub links.
Connection error UI when the app loses its backend.
Heartbeat fix to keep the app alive.

title: Initial release
changes: Automated installer for Spotify, Spicetify CLI, Marketplace and Themes.
Terminal-styled control center: status, extensions, custom apps, themes and backups.
Integrated Spotify player controls via native Win32 API.
Backup export and import (.zip).
